text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Speaking of which, the gardener mentioned the other day...
that he might finally be able to make that
difficult new breed of flower bloom...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—O gardener.
How fares the work? Have they bloomed?

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Gardener
text_block_list.text:
Lady Rose...! F-Forgive me, please...
The truth is... the flowers fell ill...
And after I so dearly wanted to present them to you this time...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Lift your head. Do not fret over it, simply devote yourself.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(............ Things rarely go as desired.
How truly pitiful...—)
